records.issue_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/decodeOAuthState.ts:9 — JSON.parse(req.query.state)` on a user-controlled query parameter is unguarded; a malformed `state` value throws an uncaught SyntaxError instead of a handled 4xx response, and callers (e.g. createOAuthAppCredential) do not wrap this in try/catch.

packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts:96 — prisma.credential.update` is called but `prisma` is never imported in this file, causing a ReferenceError on every token refresh (getClient runs in the constructor).
records.rationale: In the diff for `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, new logic calls `await prisma.credential.update({ ... })`, but the imports shown at the top include `jsforce`, `RRule`, `z`, and utilities—no `import prisma from "@calcom/prisma";` is added. Based on the diff alone, `prisma` would be undefined at runtime, causing a ReferenceError when this refresh path runs.

records.issue_text: apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:20 — Webhook secret check (`req.headers[...] !== process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) fails open: if CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset, both sides are `undefined` and the strict-inequality check silently passes, letting an unauthenticated attacker create/overwrite any user's app credentials.
records.rationale: The handler first gates the entire endpoint on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:16-18). That constant is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (packages/lib/constants.ts), so if `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset/falsy the request is rejected with 403 before the header/secret comparison runs. records.issue_text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:9 — The sync-endpoint fetch never checks `response.ok`/status before returning the Response to callers, so an error page, 500, or empty body from CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is passed through as if it were a valid token response, deferring/obscuring failure detection to inconsistent per-provider parsing code.
records.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT branch does `const response = await fetch(...); return response;` without any `response.ok`/status handling.
